# The cases the suite EXPECTS to skip on the Windows runner of `verifier`, one per line, exact
# name. Same gate as `.github/cas-ignores-attendus.txt` (which is the Linux list): a skipped
# case not listed here fails the build (a control just went dark), and a listed case that now
# runs fails it too (the list lies; tighten it, never widen it without a written reason).
#
# What is structural to a Windows runner, and why:
#
# - swiftc and the Vision framework are macOS only: the five image-reader cases skip here, as
#   on Linux, and say so.
# - `identite` and the Cascade family repositories are development neighbours that live on no
#   public runner: the three layer-comparison cases skip here too.
#
# Anything else that a Windows runner cannot run belongs here WITH its reason, added when the
# suite names it, never in advance and never in silence.
